triggerCases.prompt: Write a concise pull-request description from this completed diff.
Update this pull request's description to match its current diff and preserve the issue link.
Review this pull request and give me actionable findings.
Implement the dialog focus fix and verify it.

outputCases.prompt: Draft the pull-request description locally. Do not update GitHub.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A concise description that follows the repository template, preserves existing context, and gives behavior-focused verification without changing GitHub.
assertions: The draft preserves the related issue link and manually added keyboard-regression note, and uses the repository's What, Why, How, and Testing Instructions headings.
The What and Why sections lead with the user-visible focus-restoration outcome rather than implementation mechanics.
Testing Instructions describe the exact dialog interaction and expected focus result.
Routine lint and unit-test commands are omitted from the primary manual instructions or placed in secondary details.
The workflow returns a local draft and does not update the remote pull request.

outputCases.prompt: Record the supplied exact-head evaluation result under the active standing authorization.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A narrow remote update to the existing authored draft pull request's evaluation section that preserves all other content and metadata.
assertions: The workflow verifies that the standing authorization explicitly grants the Evaluation-section write and matches the repository, existing authored draft pull request, task branch, evaluated head, public tracked payload, OpenAI Codex destination, and bounded rerun.
The workflow reads the current description and changes only its Evaluation section to record the supplied exact head and results.
The workflow preserves the issue links, What, Why, How, Testing Instructions, and manual reviewer note exactly in meaning.
The workflow does not change the title or other metadata, post comments or reviews, resolve threads, mark ready, merge, or release.

outputCases.prompt: Record the supplied evaluation result under the standing authorization.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A denied remote update because the requested pull request, task branch, and evaluated head do not match the target recorded by the standing authorization and active review loop.
assertions: The workflow detects that repository-level evaluation data consent does not authorize an Evaluation-section write to a different pull request, branch, or head.
The workflow does not update either pull request or change any title, metadata, comments, reviews, threads, ready state, merge state, or release state.
The workflow requires a fresh explicit PR-write authorization or a matching active-loop target instead of treating authorship, public data, or the shared repository as sufficient.
